mentions.name: datenba.ch
mentions.description: A hyper-local "digital village" platform bundling small, practical community tools under one umbrella for rural German communities, combining off-the-shelf software with purpose-built projects. Current focus areas include help!, a neighbor-to-neighbor help board for rides, errands, PC help, and garden/handwork, and hubs!, a tool for shared spaces, tool-sharing, events, and social hubs. Work in progress covers the integration surface (claims, roles, provisioning), onboarding polish, and designing help!/hubs! to stay useful even with low activity.
mentions.problem: Another social network does not fit hyper-local community needs, and community tools struggle to remain useful when activity is low.
mentions.audience: residents of a few small communities in rural Germany (Neckartal/Odenwald area)
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building datenba.ch, a hyper-local “digital village” for a few small communities in rural Germany (Neckartal/Odenwald-ish).
